text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Today's result would be acceptable<n>to most, but
not to me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Second or third is not enough. I must<n>inspire awe
in all who see me run.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Any less, and I shall never realize my<n>dream.
choice_data_list: Well, I know how hard you tried. Good job today.

Next time we'll show them how the Emperor
races.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, I did. Thank you. I apologize if<n>I've gotten
ahead of myself.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If I am falling short, there is nothing<n>for it but to
work harder. Today, I<n>recover my strength.
Tomorrow, I<n>resume my training!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
An Emperor stands above the rest<n>and leads from
the front.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Forward I must march, and I will not<n>stop until I
reach my goal!
